purpose: Execute the daily loop without mixing stable strategy, operating performance, topic opportunity research, benchmark supply, execution plans, or presentation artifacts.
handoff_policy: Load the confirmed strategy boundary, run independent evidence producers in parallel, persist each handoff, join at explicit gates, then render sequentially. A node may only write its declared outputs and may never reinterpret another data domain.

nodes.function: Read current account/post performance and produce tactical content constraints.
nodes.outputs_mean: Hook, pacing, duration, proof timing, CTA, and topic-mix constraints.

nodes.function: Normalize first-party comments, messages, questions and user language without reading operating conclusions or benchmark content.
Search strategy-bounded current interests, industry/tool changes, market tasks and content gaps without selecting topics.
Load the durable account direction that bounds topic discovery.
nodes.gate: Formal topic work requires account.profile positioning_status=confirmed with explicit positioning provenance, plus strategy-brief.status=confirmed and confirmed_by_user=true. Generic approval of an implementation plan is not positioning confirmation.

nodes.function: Separate direction evidence from execution, cadence, audience-quality and conversion evidence; choose continue_current, optimize_execution, run_validation_experiment or propose_strategy_adjustment before searching for topics.
nodes.gate: propose_strategy_adjustment requires at least 3 comparable public posts, 2 execution variants and persistently weak target response. Insufficient evidence becomes run_validation_experiment.
must_not: treat one post or one hot topic as a strategy change

nodes.function: Join independently collected audience and market evidence with the confirmed search boundary and strategy-health decision, preserving evidence roles.
must_not: reduce topic discovery to pain-point collection
let a hot topic change strategy

nodes.function: Fan out to two isolated writers: conservative 60% and experimental 40%; rank only inside each lane.
nodes.required_lineage: topic_id -> lane -> strategy_id -> strategy_assessment_id -> account_fit -> search_scope_ids -> signal_ids; pain_id is optional
nodes.gate: Conservative topics must be core with all account-fit gates true. Experimental topics require persona and first-person proof, an expiry and a validation hypothesis. Shared words such as AI/workflow/efficiency are insufficient.

nodes.function: Join ready lane outputs and select two conservative plus one experimental topic without recomputing a global score.
nodes.gate: Both lanes ready and current; no rejected or expired topic; daily mix exactly 2 conservative + 1 experimental.

nodes.function: Fan out per mixed-selection topic, find supply-side examples and learn packaging structure without changing lane membership.
nodes.outputs_mean: Hook, proof, structure, pacing, and CTA patterns only.
must_not: call a sample viral without a real metric

nodes.function: Apply operations constraints and benchmark structures to candidate topics.
must_not: turn an operations metric into account direction

nodes.function: Render upstream facts without inventing conclusions, timestamps, scores, or freshness.
nodes.gate: Unconfirmed positioning provenance, missing strategy assessment, blocked plan, incomplete search scope, missing topic signals, account-fit failure, lineage failure, or HTML mismatch prevents rendering/closure.
must_not: use file mtime as data date
treat HTML as source of truth

nodes.function: Normalize real published-post outcomes for the next operations cycle.

missing_data_behavior: Persist blockers and stop before HTML when formal topic evidence is missing.
